title: Move this board to Cloudflare Pages
details: Part of making the repo private. Merge the PR, then create a second Cloudflare Pages project (quando-board) on dendrito/quando with build command `python3 dashboard/build.py`, output `dashboard`, domain board.quando.day, optional Cloudflare Access. Steps are in dashboard/README.md. Then delete the GitHub Pages site. quando.day itself needs no change.
note: PR open; needs Curió's Cloudflare steps.
